notes.title: First Updates on Postman Simulator 🚀
notes.content:
📬 Hello everyone,

I’m thrilled to see that Postman Simulator is starting to gain interest since its arrival on Steam. Your initial reactions and support motivate me to keep giving my best to make this game a great experience.

Over the past few weeks, here’s what I’ve been working on:
[list][*][b]Old City stamps[/b]: Unique designs that enrich the game’s universe.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45409494/d3e85f6301caaf62e4bd43ae842cbd2a9df31104.png[/img]
[*][b]The postman’s bag[/b]: Redesigned in Blender to be both simple and immersive.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45409494/5b4ddaea31a9a9fb1b85d452f82e565a6781d93a.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45409494/f9fd40ef77017e02b5301eaf486ce1cba96c711b.png[/img]
[*][b]Envelope weighing[/b]: A mechanic that allows you to verify postage based on weight.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45409494/f9b991b8a38a7e921631f6f7cc87dca783a5ada4.png[/img]
[*][b]Inventory overhaul[/b]: Improved usability with a filtering system currently in progress.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45409494/c889531e4c3f073794865c8c90083bef4933ae82.png[/img]
[/list]
This is just the beginning. Every detail matters to make Postman Simulator as immersive and enjoyable as possible, and I’m excited to show you even more in the weeks and months to come.

If you haven’t already, don’t forget to add the game to your Steam wishlist. Thank you for your support, and see you soon for more updates! 🚀
